(async () => { await window.raid.fresh(); await window.raid.hold(true); await window.raid.taught(); return await 'a new member, clock held'; })()
(async () => { await window.raid.start(11, 0); await window.raid.skip(1.2); return await 'first pick'; })()
(async () => { await document.querySelector("[data-pick='0']")?.click(); await window.raid.settled(); await window.raid.skip(0.5); return await JSON.stringify(window.raid.state().choice); })()
(async () => { await window.raid.bot(6); await window.raid.plan(); await window.raid.skip(1.5); return await 'room 7'; })()
(async () => {const id=await window.raid.give('glorp'); window.raid.skip(0.3); window.raid.tap(id); window.raid.skip(0.3); return 'glorp '+id})()

(async () => { for (const p of window.raid.party().filter((p) => p.on === 'board').slice(1)) await window.raid.send({ do: 'bench', seat: p.at }); await window.raid.fight(); await window.raid.tick(120); return await window.raid.busy(200); })()

(()=>{window.raid.tally('damage'); for(let i=0;i<4000&&!window.raid.state().fight.over;i++)window.raid.tick(1); window.raid.skip(1); window.raid.skip(3); return JSON.stringify([window.raid.state().mode, window.raid.state().fight.result])})()

(async () => { await window.raid.carry(); await window.raid.skip(1.5); await document.querySelector("[data-pick='0']")?.click(); await window.raid.settled(); await window.raid.skip(2); return await window.raid.last(); })()
(async () => { await window.raid.last(); await window.raid.start(5, 0); await window.raid.skip(1.2); return await 'a new raid'; })()
(async () => { await document.querySelector("[data-pick='0']")?.click(); await window.raid.settled(); await window.raid.skip(0.5); return await JSON.stringify(window.raid.state().choice); })()

(async () => {window.raid.skip(1.5); await window.raid.fight(); for(let i=0;i<4000&&!window.raid.state().fight.over;i++)window.raid.tick(1); window.raid.skip(1); window.raid.skip(3); return JSON.stringify([window.raid.state().mode, window.raid.state().fight.result])})()
